description: Properties of the 48 building archetypes used to characterise the building stock of the City of Melbourne, Australia is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors André Stephan, Aristide Athanassiadis. This dataset presents the different assemblies used to characterise each of the 48 different building archetypes used to characterise the building stock of the City of Melbourne, Australia. Coverage: national (AU); the metadata date the deposit to 2016. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 25375 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
